teach_desc: Add images to each class to train the recognition algorithm.
test_desc: Provide a test image to validate the model's prediction.
diag_desc: Analyze the distribution of hits and misses to evaluate model generalization.
test_env_desc: Upload a holdout set of images to populate the confusion matrix.
error_min_samples: Please add at least 3 images in total to train the model.
matrix_note: Values on the diagonal represent correct predictions (True Positives). Off-diagonal values indicate misclassifications and potential dataset bias.
explanation_desc: Red zones show where the AI focused the most to make its decision.
click_cell_hint: Click a cell to inspect its samples.
inspector_hint: sample(s) — click one to generate its importance map
reset_modal_desc_1: Are you sure you want to start over? All images and the trained model will be
save_dataset_desc: Save the current configuration (classes and images) as a reusable dataset for this session.
save_dataset_error_empty: Add at least 2 classes and 1 image before saving.
save_dataset_error_name: Please enter a name for the dataset.
dtree_note: The decision tree is a simplified model built from the same MobileNet embeddings as the neural classifier. Each internal node splits samples by a feature threshold. Leaves show the predicted class and confidence.
dtree_awaiting: Click 'Run Diagnostics' to generate the decision tree.
dtree_how_split_body: Each white box splits images based on a value from the neural network. The green branch follows when the value is low, the red when it is high.
dtree_how_leaf_body: Coloured boxes are the final result. They show the predicted class and the confidence with which the tree made that decision.
dtree_how_bar_body: The bar at the bottom of each box shows how many images from each class passed through it. The more uniform the colour, the better the split.
dtree_how_stats_body: n is the number of images that reached that point. Gini measures how mixed the classes are: 0 means a perfect split, higher values mean more confusion.
llm_tab_desc: Discover how language models that generate text actually work, from reading words to choosing responses, in an interactive way.
tok_desc: Computers do not read whole words directly. They break text into smaller chunks called tokens and assign a unique number (ID) to each. This enables efficient text processing.
tok_input_placeholder: Type something to see how it is tokenized in real-time...
tok_hover_hint: Hover over colored tokens to see their corresponding IDs and representations below.
dec_desc: An LLM is a giant guessing game: it computes a probability for every possible next word. Adjusting Temperature and Top-P changes how the model selects the final word.
dec_prompt_label: Select a starting prompt to simulate:
dec_temp_desc: Zero (0) makes the AI strictly logical and predictable. Higher values (e.g. 1.5) flatten probabilities, allowing creative, unexpected, or irrational choices.
dec_topp_desc: Limits the choice only to the most likely words that make up the top P% of the probability mass. Others are excluded (greyed out) to filter out gibberish.
att_desc: The secret sauce of modern LLMs is Attention. When processing a word (such as a pronoun), the network focuses on the most relevant words in the previous context. Hover over the blue highlighted words below to see where the attention focuses!
att_hover_hint: Hover over the blue words to visualize attention intensity (values in %).
tok_stats_cost_tooltip: Calculated based on a rate of $2.50 per 1 million input tokens (GPT-4o).
tok_g_explanation: In modern subword tokenizers (like GPT-4's BPE), the special character Ġ represents a leading space. This helps the model handle spacing robustly and identify where each word begins.
dec_note: * Note: The numbers in parentheses represent the Logits (model's raw affinity scores). The Temperature scales these logits before the Softmax exponentiation, sharpening or smoothing the resulting probabilities.
home_hero_title: Bold Ideas That Start With Vision.
home_hero_subtitle: An interactive laboratory to train computer vision models and explore the inner mechanics of large language models.
home_trusted_by: Explore the core branches of modern AI
home_cv_card_desc: Train Computer Vision models directly in your browser. Capture live webcam frames or sketch on-screen to teach the AI in real time, evaluate precision with interactive confusion matrices, and dissect neural logic through visual decision trees.
home_llm_card_desc: Uncover the inner workings of generative artificial intelligence. Explore text tokenization in real time, adjust Temperature and Top-P to control writing creativity, and visualize how the Attention mechanism connects concepts instantly.
